issue_context.title: Formatter: Preserve parentheses of yielded value
issue_context.body:
Black seems (need confirmation) to preserve parentheses around the yielded value:

## Input / Output
```python
yield ("Cache key will cause errors if used with memcached: %r " "(longer than %s)" % (
        key,
        MEMCACHE_MAX_KEY_LENGTH,
     )
)

yield "Cache key will cause errors if used with memcached: %r " "(longer than %s)" % (
    key,
    MEMCACHE_MAX_KEY_LENGTH,
)
 
 
yield ("Unnecessary")


yield (
    "#   * Make sure each ForeignKey and OneToOneField has `on_delete` set "
    "to the desired behavior"
)
yield (
    "#   * Remove `managed = False` lines if you wish to allow "
    "Django to create, modify, and delete the table"
)
yield (
    "# Feel free to rename the models, but don't rename db_table values or "
    "field names."
)

yield "#   * Make sure each ForeignKey and OneToOneField has `on_delete` set "    "to the desired behavior"
yield "#   * Remove `managed = False` lines if you wish to allow " "Django to create, modify, and delete the table"
yield "# Feel free to rename the models, but don't rename db_table values or "    "field names."
```

## Ruff

Always removes the parentheses.

review_comments: I dislike that `yield` and `await` expressions are inconsistent. Should we keep it as is and mark this an intentional deviation (I would still merge the change because using `IfBreaks` instead of `IfRequired` cleans up the expression logic)
This layout is now exclusively used by `With` statements, the one below for function return types.
Applying this logic to all parenthesized cases reduces the overall number of branches.
